outcome: Incidence of hypertensive diseases of pregnancy (HDP)
cohort: 100 pregnant women, with 50 in the study group (≥ 40 years old) and 50 in the control group (< 40 years old)
finding: Pregnancies in women over 40 years old are associated with a higher risk course, including increased rates of IVF pregnancies, medical comorbidities, fibroids, preterm deliveries, and potentially higher cesarean section rates.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was higher in the elderly group (≥ 40 years old), although the difference was not statistically significant.
birth_weight: Measured but not specified in the findings
